arStrings.szText: May the light guide you to take the path less traveled. Complete the{icon:Marker_SeasonQuestProgress,2.5}{c_important}"Call of the Paladin"{/c} Quest then speak with the Paladin Justelle near the Amber Sand in Kehjistan and complete the{icon:Marker_SideQuestProgress_Untracked,2.5}{c_important}"Path of the Paladin"{/c} Side Quest.
